entries.name: Downstairs at The Dome
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Squarespace 'Events List' block on the venue's own /whatson page — server-rendered <article class="eventlist-event"> cards, each with a title link and a machine-readable <time class="event-date" datetime> — extracted by the new, small, generic ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ module (shared with Night Tales Loft/The Roxy, all three genuinely serve one of Squarespace's two documented event-block shapes). 101 real gig cards live-verified this package (POLIÇA, RATBOYS, WINE LIPS, A PLACE TO BURY STRANGERS, ...).
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 101 event cards live-fetched at proof time, overwhelmingly band/act names — MUSIC GATE: predominantly and reliably music-relevant.

research_provenance.note: Salvaged from the prior BEATMAPPED-LONDON-ALL-VENUE-RECOVERY-AND-FIRST-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 research (venue identity/address/coordinates), but re-verified live against current main and re-acquired via a new generic module (ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/) since main's own generic static-cards collector does not match this site's real markup.

entries.name: Night Tales Loft

entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 38 event cards live-fetched at proof time, entirely DJ/club-night bookings — MUSIC GATE: predominantly and reliably music-relevant.

research_provenance.note: Salvaged from the prior donor branch's research; re-verified live and re-acquired via ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ against current main.

entries.name: The Roxy
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Squarespace 'Summary Block' (event record type) on the venue's own /whatson page — server-rendered <div class="summary-item ... summary-item-record-type-event"> cards carrying a real data-title attribute and a genuine data-upcoming-event-end millisecond timestamp; extracted by the same ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ module's second block-shape path. 39 real club-night/live-music cards live-verified this package (ROXY TUESDAYS, NEON NIGHTS: LIVE MUSIC SHOWCASE + BATTLE JAM, ...). The venue's own page title is literally 'Live Music, Club Nights & Events London'.
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 39 event cards live-fetched at proof time — MUSIC GATE: predominantly and reliably music-relevant (venue's own stated primary purpose is live music/club nights).

research_provenance.note: Salvaged from the prior donor branch's research; re-verified live and re-acquired via ingestion/squarespace-eventlist/ against current main.

entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 18 event cards live-fetched at proof time. MUSIC GATE reviewed per-title: 1 comedy booking ("CLINTON BAPTISTE'S SUNDAY SEANCE") and 1 unidentifiable placeholder ("UNTITLED") excluded as NON_MUSIC/AMBIGUOUS; the remaining 16 are real band/act bookings.

research_provenance.note: Ported unchanged from the donor branch's own ingestion/100-club/observation-adapter.mjs (verified byte-for-byte still functional against a fresh live fetch under this package before porting).

entries.research_notes: 47 event cards live-fetched at proof time, entirely rock/metal/punk band bookings and recurring club nights (Blackout Club, Camden Rocks Club) — MUSIC GATE: 100% music-relevant, no exclusions needed.

entries.name: Eventim Apollo
entries.municipality: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Custom AEG-hosted venue CMS (schema.org MusicVenue self-classification; formerly Hammersmith Apollo). No per-event JSON-LD Event/MusicEvent objects anywhere; real static event cards (title + complete text date + first-party /events/<slug> detail link) extracted directly by the new, small, generic ingestion/aeg-presents/ module. 82 real cards live-verified this package.
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 82 event cards live-fetched at proof time. MUSIC GATE reviewed per-title against the venue's own full current listing (no source-exposed category field exists): 53 confirmed genuine concerts/orchestral-in-concert shows kept via a curated, evidence-cited inclusion list (ingestion/aeg-presents/filter.mjs); 29 comedy sets, author/podcast talks, and ambiguous titles excluded. See research/source-investigations/london-t2-eventim-apollo-03/.

research_provenance.note: New generic ingestion/aeg-presents/ collector, built and live-verified this package against the venue's own real /events/ index. Same platform family as sibling candidate Watford Colosseum (deferred this tranche — see research/source-investigations/london-t2-watford-colosseum-03/ — for being geographically outside Greater London and the existing UK map view bounds, not for any data-quality reason).

entries.name: Jamboree
entries.acquisition_path_detail: WordPress 'Events Manager' plugin; no ICS export, no JSON-LD Event block, no JSON/REST API for events — but real static event cards (title + complete text date + first-party /events/<slug>/ detail link + a source-provided <h4> programme note) extracted directly by the small bespoke ingestion/jamboree/observation-adapter.mjs. 14 real cards live-verified this package.
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 14 event cards live-fetched at proof time. MUSIC GATE: every card's own <h4> programme-note text deterministically distinguishes music ('Live Music from ...') from the venue's recurring dance/art classes ('Class Runs from ...') — 10 kept, 3 recurring classes excluded, 1 ambiguous spoken-word/open-mic night ('Word Space') excluded. See research/source-investigations/london-t2-jamboree-03/.

research_provenance.note: New bespoke ingestion/jamboree/observation-adapter.mjs + filter.mjs, built and live-verified this package against the venue's own real /upcoming-events/ page.
